MODULE: carrier/channels.py -- the QUANTUM-CHANNEL LIBRARY of the carrier: single/two-qubit
rotation unitaries (rx/ry/rz/rzz/rxx/ryy/rxx_ryy/controlled_phase_error/single_axis/two_pauli),
one/two-qutrit Kraus channels (amplitude/phase damping, thermal relaxation+excitation, reset,
leakage-relaxation surrogate, correlated relaxation, two-qubit depolarizing, custom non-Pauli,
weak type-4 mixing, stochastic Pauli), the Wood-Gambetta qutrit leakage superoperator + Kraus
(scipy.linalg.expm of a Lindbladian generator), the readout-bias matrix, and the MechanismSpec
contract layer (audit_dict / operation-axis / error-axis / definition_contract / channel dispatch
over M0..M34). It is a pure numpy + scipy channel library -- it imports NEITHER torch NOR quimb, so
EVERY public unit is CPU-PURE and IN-SCOPE for full L0+L1+L2 -- out_of_scope is therefore {} (the
AST reconcile refuses any gpu_bound claim on a torch-less module).
THIRTY-THREE public units (AST reconcile: every top-level public def + every public method of a
top-level class; the load-bearing __post_init__ dunder is kept, so MechanismSpec contributes TWO
units -- __post_init__ (construction contract) + audit_dict):
* 31 module functions: canonical_single_qubit_axis, mechanism_operation_axis,
mechanism_error_axis, mechanism_definition_contract, mechanism_channel, rzz_unitary, rx_unitary,
ry_unitary, rz_unitary, rxx_unitary, ryy_unitary, rxx_ryy_unitary, controlled_phase_error_unitary,
drifted_axis_mixture_kraus, single_axis_rotation, pauli_stochastic_kraus, amplitude_damping_kraus,
phase_damping_kraus, phase_damping_canonical_kraus, thermal_relaxation_kraus,
thermal_excitation_kraus, reset_to_state_kraus, leakage_relaxation_surrogate_kraus,
leakage_channel_super, leakage_kraus, custom_non_pauli_kraus, two_qubit_depolarizing_kraus,
correlated_relaxation_kraus, weak_type4_mixing_kraus, readout_bias_matrix, two_pauli_rotation.
* MechanismSpec.__post_init__ (construction-contract validator: non-empty id, positive
num_qubits, Mapping parameters, present axis params non-None + a valid rotation axis) +
MechanismSpec.audit_dict (the two public methods of the frozen dataclass).
THE CENTRAL RULE for this batch. assert_cptp/assert_unitary/assert_row_stochastic are NECESSARY but
VACUOUS as the ONLY check -- a physically WRONG channel is very often still CPTP (sum K^H K = I) and
a wrong rotation still unitary. So EVERY channel/unitary carries an INDEPENDENT closed-form VALUE-PIN
of the actual returned operator against the textbook form recomputed FROM SCRATCH (rotations vs
scipy.linalg.expm(-i theta/2 P) computed independently of the module's cos/sin body; Kraus vs the
textbook Kraus set; the WG leakage channel vs an INDEPENDENT expm of a from-scratch Lindbladian
generator, pinned at the CHANNEL/superoperator level since the operator-sum form is basis-free), plus
an assert_discriminates whose WRONG variant is still structurally CPTP/unitary but fails the value-pin.
assert_pins is float-only (it casts to float64), so complex operators are pinned via a thin wrapper
that feeds the real+imag components to assert_pins -- the mandated discrimination core, imaginary-part
aware. Every validation RAISE asserts its EXACT message via str(excinfo.value)==... (mutmut wraps/
roundtrips string literals -- an exact-equality kills them). Every contract/audit dict is pinned with
its EXACT string literals + structure (mutmut mutates string constants), and every mechanism_channel
branch is exercised at its DEFAULT parameters (empty params) so a mutated default constant diverges.
CONVERGENCE. Every unit is analytic (cos/sin closed forms) or an EXACT matrix exponential (expm is
exact to ~1e-14 for these small generators, not an unconverged truncation), so no pin is at an
unconverged numerical parameter and none is marked slow. The leakage channel is pinned against a
from-scratch expm of the SAME generator, stated explicitly in the test.
ONE defensive exemption. pauli_stochastic_kraus carries `if p >= NUMERICAL_ZERO:` after
p = probability_floor(...) which returns >= 1e-12 = NUMERICAL_ZERO for ANY input -- the False arc
(skip the append) is UNREACHABLE with valid inputs (the floor guarantees p >= NZ). PROBED, not
assumed: the boundary test test_L0_pauli_stochastic_floor_keeps_all_three_paulis pins that even a
ZERO input Pauli probability still yields its sqrt(1e-12)-scaled Kraus (the append fires), which is
exactly what the mutant `>=`->`>` would drop. Registered as a `line` exemption (stmt_kind=branch),
AST-revalidated by the audit; noted as a src-cleanup candidate (the guard is dead given the floor).
NO out_of_scope: every unit is CPU-pure numpy/scipy.
